value.rationale: Resolves an explicit complete multipartite stability direction in the initiating 2026 article, including a decisive exceptional threshold and complete minimum-deletion witnesses rather than just another small exact graph value. The classification extends uniformly to unbalanced multipartite graphs and identifies when smallest vertex deletion can increase, decrease, or preserve strong domination. The statement is precisely motivated by strong-domination vertex sensitivity, not an arbitrary slice.
